_comment: Route Usability Gate, LOOP requests (production canonical generator). Pre-registered and frozen before any new validation pool (IMPL1_PLAN P0). Values come from USABILITY_GATE_DESIGN.md v2.1 (sha256 984ccc140de19a9f525f61dc1cb769cd86eed12df8d2e9a26c78bcd02eb61252) sections 5-0, 5-3 (Design B), 7, 7-1; no value was tuned on outcome data.
_user_decisions: 2026-10-27: (1) Design B levels, FAIL = hard filter (candidate removed before ranking); (2) REVIEW is not shown to users: shadow / log only, written to review_queue. Lead decision D-I1 (2026-10-27): R1 trunk(+link) untagged at-grade crossing = FAIL (draft1 had REVIEW).
_revision: draft1 (ug-v1.draft1.json, sha256 3f6d3d12...) -> this file: R1.trunk level REVIEW -> FAIL (D-I1), R1.motorway registry note (N3).

F1.classify: analysis/runway_walk_filter.classify imported unchanged, applied to the source way tags (BusanSource.ways)
F1._basis: definition: RunWay RUNNABLE status; generator invariant FORBIDDEN_EDGE_USED (canonical_adapter.py:402-403); parallel-way rule: F1/F2 on both ways (env-terrain + local-network reviews)

F2._basis: definition: every traversal (u, v, osmid) must be a consecutive node pair of that way in the source extract (simplify=False graph: edge = one OSM segment)

F3._basis: definition of a LOOP route: consecutive traversals share a node, nodes[0] == nodes[-1] == snapped start (route_features 'closed', runway_route_api.verify)

F4._basis: code constant: runway_route_api.verify() accepts |sum(length) - distance| < 1 m; payload coords are rounded to 6 decimals (canonical_adapter.py:374), max rounding error 5e-7 deg < 1e-6

F6._basis: code constants REPEATED_MAX 0.20 / MAX_REPEATED_RATIO, MAX_OAB_LOOP 0.30, quality_ok uturns == 0 (runway_route_generator.py:57-58, :338; canonical_adapter.py:61-62)

F7._basis: code constant MAX_SNAP_M 250 (app_runway.py:44) = WORK_BUFFER_M (runway_busan_graph.py:64) = graph_store.MAX_SNAP_M; OutOfCoverageError

motorway._basis: Design B (env-terrain safety review): no legitimate pedestrian at-grade motorway crossing exists, any hit is a data / geometry error; applied whether or not a crossing tag is present (0 events in the existing pools either way)
motorway._registry_note: N3 (env-terrain E-I1): watch motorway_link ramp-terminal crosswalks as possible false positives; record any hit in the review registry

trunk._basis: lead decision D-I1 (2026-10-27): user decision text 'motorway/trunk 횡단' + safety-first (ambiguous -> safer and reversible); untagged at-grade trunk/trunk_link crossings FAIL, a way-level crossing tag still exempts; reversible after the manual review registry. (Design B draft had REVIEW because the extract has no node tags.)

R1.geometry: a route node where rays of the class lie on BOTH sides of the route (in-edge, out-edge); nodes with an immediate U-turn (p == q) are skipped
R1.crossing_tags_on: route ways incident to the node
R1.adjacency: all-status edges of the request graph (cg.edges_all)
R1._basis: definition (planar side test); accepted tags per local-network review (way-level crossing=*), node tags absent in the production extract (canonical_adapter UNAVAILABLE_FEATURES)

R2._basis: pre-registered physical rationale: more than one junction / crossing length of exposure in a traffic lane, about 30-36 s at running pace (design v2.1 section 7, accepted by env-terrain); highway list = runway_route_features.MAJOR

R3.condition: (layer < 0 and tunnel absent or 'no') or ford = 'yes'
R3._basis: Design B (env-terrain): consistency with classify - the same underpass tagged tunnel=yes without foot/sidewalk info is UNCERTAIN (road_tunnel_without_foot_info) and fails F1; FAIL until cleared in a review registry. Highways = runway_walk_filter.ROAD_HW. 20 m = pre-registered minimum exposure (mm resample_step_m 20)

fail._basis: Design B (env-terrain): no general access, effectively ACCESS_DENY (issue I-3)

review._basis: OSM access semantics: restricted values outside ACCESS_DENY {no, private}

R4._basis: pre-registered value lists (design v2.1 section 7-1); 20 m minimum exposure (mm resample_step_m)

fail._basis: Design B (env-terrain): SAC T4-T6 (hands, exposure) is not runnable terrain for a general user

review._basis: SAC T3: borderline, irregular tagging on footways

R5._basis: external grading definition (SAC scale); 20 m minimum exposure (mm resample_step_m)

parallel_way_attribution.F1_F2: both the adapter eid way and the canonical edge_sequence way; FAIL if either fails
parallel_way_attribution.R_rules: adapter eid way only (the way whose features / payload the user receives)
parallel_way_attribution.canonical_way_R_results: logged as alt_way_review, never change the verdict
parallel_way_attribution._basis: env-terrain F1 condition 2 + local-network review U-L1 point 3

stage_b.target: every record of the re-ranked active list that is shown (TOP-k)
stage_b.refill: only when a Stage B rule fails (expected 0 in production)

observations._basis: observation only (no effect on verdict). Closure patterns exclude '임시' (only hit in Busan is the street name 임시수도기념로); hairpin 150 deg = physical 'almost reversing' definition used in the audit

confidence.gpx_overlap: internal only (analysis_permission UNKNOWN); never overrides, softens or reorders any F/R/PE result, not even as a tie-breaker
confidence._basis: design v2.1 section 6; env-terrain review Q5
